systems.title: Entrypoint & Config

modules.title: Distillation Workflow
modules.summary: 按角色与 scenario 复用或采集数据并执行 Bootstrap 与多轮累计 DAgger
modules.owns: artifact preflight scenario manifest quota stage machine checkpoint lineage outer iteration barrier resume 与 fork
modules.mustNot: 不加载大 tensor 来判断文件存在性, 不在 scenario collection 中发布 student_(k+1), 不把 route pass 当作物理质量

files.role: formal parent-lineage command freeze and oracle owner
thin FT-0 no-training identity, aggregate-workload, and artifact connector

mainRoute: B1 preflight_role_artifacts(): role contract + immutable files -> REUSE/COLLECT/STALE/INCOMPATIBLE
B2 WorkflowScenarioSpec: scenario roles + quota -> manifest contract
B3 run_bootstrap_workflow(): role decisions -> collected/reused role data + bootstrap checkpoint
B4 run_multirole_dagger_workflow(): activate student_k checkpoint/version once + scenarios -> cumulative dataset + student_(k+1)
B5 fork_workflow_run(): completed parent sources + scenario/row-role identity -> resumable active-schema chain

检查同一 iteration 全部 scenario 是否共享 student_k checkpoint/version
检查 student_(k+1) activation 是否晚于 updater

systems.title: Teacher Evidence & Dataset
systems.summary: 构造带 teacher action command intent 和 role 的可追踪训练证据

modules.title: Teacher Policy
modules.summary: 加载并冻结 SAC teacher actor
modules.owns: teacher input dimension actor architecture optional normalizer 与 detached action
modules.mustNot: 不决定某个 observation 属于 standing walking 或 height role
mainRoute: B1 teacher.py::validate_sac_teacher_checkpoint_contract(): checkpoint + spec -> verified actor input dim
B2 teacher.py::load_sac_teacher_policy(): verified checkpoint -> frozen SAC actor
B3 LoadedTeacherPolicy.forward(): teacher observation -> detached teacher action
review: 确认 teacher task 和 checkpoint 语义一致
确认 normalizer 状态没有被静默忽略

modules.title: Role Collector
modules.summary: 在 live env 中按 command intent 采集 teacher 或 student rollout 状态; transition collector 作为独立场景 owner
modules.owns: obs projection action source command filter done reset command-conditioned rollout expert selection collection metadata 与 opt-in stage observations
modules.mustNot: 不训练 student, 不把 finite action 当作物理质量
mainRoute: B1 collector.py projection: env obs dict -> 98-D student/teacher rows
B2 collector.py command mask: commands + thresholds -> selected intent rows
B3 collector.py rollout/label policies: selected states -> teacher targets + executed actions
B4 transition owner: student-state rows -> atomic active/zero command switch -> command-intent rollout expert -> role-labelled targets
B5 build_distillation_dataset(): collected chunks -> persisted semantic dataset
B6 opt-in performance accumulator: owner spans -> copied dataset metadata -> worker pass-through
review: 检查 inactive 数据是否真的零指令
检查 done/reset 后的行是否仍保持语义
modules.gap: collector 与 reset/resource timing 已通过 E61/E65/E67 runtime-confirmed, 但端到端 NO_STABLE_SPEEDUP; HP-6/E86 production gate PASS; RT-10 physical acceptance 未完成

modules.title: Distillation Dataset
modules.summary: 验证 保存 加载并合并 role-labelled 与 transition-labelled tensor evidence
modules.owns: tensor shape optional fields label preservation transition chronology metadata 与 batch slicing
modules.mustNot: 不改变 teacher action 或重新解释 command intent
mainRoute: B1 build_distillation_dataset(): raw tensors + labels -> validated role dataset
B2 save/load helpers: validated dataset -> roundtrip artifact
B3 build_multitask_distillation_dataset(): role sources -> merged stand/walk dataset
review: 检查 98-D contract 与所有 source 一致
确认 role 与 intent 在 roundtrip 后未丢失

systems.title: Student Learning
systems.summary: 用角色动作监督 MoE expert 并聚合 student-state evidence

modules.title: MoE Student
modules.summary: 计算所有 expert action 与 router 输出并生成一个 29-D action
modules.owns: expert networks router logits route probabilities hard/soft action composition
modules.mustNot: 不从 checkpoint 文件名推断角色, 不拥有 command threshold
mainRoute: B1 MoEStudentPolicy._validate_obs(): actor obs -> valid 98-D batch
B2 expert/router forward: valid obs -> expert actions + route probabilities
B3 routing composition: expert outputs + mode -> one student action
review: 确认 expert 0/1 的语义来自 contract
确认 soft mixture 不冒充 pure expert 验收
modules.gap: expert 2 当前无 accepted teacher role

modules.title: Behavior Trainer
modules.summary: 把 detached teacher action 监督到 intent-selected expert
modules.owns: behavior loss router losses selected expert gradients 与 optimizer step
modules.mustNot: 不采集 env state, 不决定 checkpoint 是否物理合格
mainRoute: B1 trainer.update(): batch teacher fields -> detached teacher action
B2 _expert_behavior_action(): role/intent labels -> selected expert action
B3 loss composition: selected action + target -> behavior/router losses
B4 gradient isolation + optimizer: loss -> updated active expert parameters
review: 确认 inactive expert grad=None
确认 router loss 系数与部署路由语义一致
modules.gap: 低单步 MSE 仍不能推出闭环稳定

modules.title: Student-State DAgger
modules.summary: 执行当前角色 expert 查询 teacher 并聚合历轮状态
modules.owns: fixed and command-conditioned rollout expert iteration aggregation immediate updates 与 DAgger metadata
modules.mustNot: 不使用 soft mixture 代表 pure role expert, 不覆盖旧迭代数据

files.role: invocation-local balanced label-pool cache, replay-budget, and offline learner staging owner

mainRoute: B1 _resolve_dagger_rollout_policy(): intent/role mapping -> fixed rollout expert
B2 collect_distillation_dataset_from_env(): current expert states -> teacher-labelled iteration dataset
B3 _aggregate_dagger_datasets(): prior + current iterations -> cumulative evidence
B4 run_offline_distillation_updates(): one immutable pool cache per loaded cumulative dataset -> equivalent balanced batches -> updated selected expert
review: 检查 rollout/loss/deploy expert 三者一致
检查每轮数据量与真实 episode 覆盖
tests: S2 iterative aggregation and formal offline integration
modules.gap: HP-7c owner/S1/S2 and E95 production-path CUDA sentinel pass; bounded persistent end-to-end evidence pending; repeated-reset 与 walk-to-stop acceptance remains separate

systems.title: Persistence & Deployment
systems.summary: 保存一个 student artifact 并在 MuJoCo 中按 command intent 执行

modules.title: Checkpoint Payload
modules.summary: 持久化 student optimizer runtime config 与 teacher metadata
modules.owns: state_dict payload serialization strict load 与可选 normalizer
modules.mustNot: 不根据文件大小判断网络完整性或物理质量
mainRoute: B1 save_distillation_checkpoint(): student/runtime metadata -> .pt payload
B2 load_distillation_checkpoint(): .pt payload -> strict student state
B3 optional resume: optimizer/normalizer state -> continued training state
review: 区分推理模型字节与 optimizer 字节
检查 parent/teacher identity 是否足够
modules.gap: workflow 已记录 immutable hash 与 parent identity; promoted identity 尚未实现

modules.title: Interactive Playback
modules.summary: 加载 student checkpoint 并把 command intent 映射为部署 expert action
modules.owns: checkpoint resolution policy obs extraction command routing session stepping 与 trace
modules.mustNot: 不把 finite/nonzero action 当作稳定, 不静默替换 checkpoint identity
mainRoute: B1 checkpoint resolver: launch args -> exact student artifact
B2 create_distill_playback_session(): checkpoint + task cfg -> policy session
B3 command-intent routing: current command + runtime mapping -> selected expert action
B4 RslRlPlaybackSession.step_once(): action -> MuJoCo next state
review: 每次首先核对 checkpoint path/agent_steps/hash
检查 stop command 后是否恢复 stand expert 与平衡
tests: S4 repeated reset and transition PENDING
modules.gap: 现有 sentinel 不验证 base height tilt termination 或重复启动
